item.title: ইরানের বিপ্লবী মূল্যবোধ রক্ষায় তরুণীদের অস্ত্র প্রশিক্ষণ
item.description: ইসলামিক প্রজাতন্ত্রটির আদর্শ রক্ষার জন্য তিন কোটি ইরানি নাগরিক জানফাদা নামের একটি পদক্ষেপে অংশ নিচ্ছেন। বিভিন্ন বয়সের মানুষের পাশাপাশি তরুণীরাও এই সামরিক মহড়ায় অস্ত্র ও নানা সরঞ্জাম চালানোর প্রশিক্ষণ নিচ্ছেন।

item.title: শতবর্ষ আগে নিষিদ্ধ নাটক যা স্তালিন চৌদ্দবার দেখেন
item.description: জারশাসনের পতনের পর কিয়েভ শহরের পটভূমিতে রচিত এক শতবর্ষ পুরনো নাটক অতীতে নিষিদ্ধ থাকলেও জোসেফ স্তালিন এটি চৌদ্দবার উপভোগ করেছিলেন। গৃহযুদ্ধের সংঘাতের মাঝেও একটি পরিবার তাদের পুরোনো মূল্যবোধ টিকিয়ে রাখার চেষ্টা করে।

item.title: খেজুর ও কুমড়ার বীজের স্বাস্থ্যকর নাশতা
item.description: বিকেলের হালকা ক্ষুধায় খেজুর ও কুমড়ার বীজের মিশ্রণ বেশ উপযোগী। প্রাকৃতিক চিনি, আমিষ এবং খনিজের এই সমন্বয় খাদ্যতালিকায় পুষ্টির যোগান বাড়ায়।

item.title: দফতর ও চেয়ার ছেড়ে বিদায়ের কবিতা
item.description: দফতর ও চেয়ারের দায়িত্ব শেষ করে বিদায় নেওয়ার অভিব্যক্তি প্রকাশ পেয়েছে। চাবির দায়িত্ব ফিরিয়ে দিয়ে এবং শেষ বার্তা প্রত্যাশা করে এই প্রস্থান।

item.title: আজকের টেলিভিশন ও অনলাইন ক্রীড়া সূচি
item.description: বিশ্বের সেরা ফুটবলারের সম্মানজনক ব্যালন ডি’অর পুরস্কার আজ দেওয়া হবে। অনুষ্ঠানটি সরাসরি উপভোগ করতে অফিসিয়াল ওয়েবসাইট ও ডিএজেডএনে নজর রাখা যাবে।

item.title: বর্ষায় পুঁটি মাছে লাল রঙের কারণ
item.description: বর্ষাকালে স্থির জলের পাশে ধানখেতের খালের পানিতে পুঁটি মাছের শরীরে ভিন্ন রঙের খেলা দেখা যায়। এই ঋতুতে মাছের বাহ্যিক রূপের পরিবর্তন ঘটে।

item.title: শারীরিক মৃত্যুর পরেও কোষের বেঁচে থাকার রহস্য
item.description: হৃৎপিণ্ড ও মস্তিষ্কের কার্যক্রম বন্ধ হয়ে পচন শুরুর প্রচলিত ধারণার বাইরেও মৃত্যুর পরেও মানবদেহের কিছু কোষ সচল থাকে। দীর্ঘকাল ধরে চলা এই ধারণার বাইরে বিজ্ঞান নতুন তথ্য তুলে ধরেছে।

item.title: গোলাপি সাটিন পোশাকে জয়া আহসানের নতুন আলোকচিত্র
item.description: অভিনেত্রী জয়া আহসান প্যাস্টেল গোলাপি রঙের সাটিন পোশাকে ক্যামেরাবন্দি হয়েছেন। স্লিপ ড্রেসটিতে ডিপ নেকলাইন এবং ক্রিসক্রস স্ট্র্যাপের পাশাপাশি চুল খোলা রাখা হয়েছিল।

item.title: Serbian leader Vucic acknowledges defeat to student protesters
item.description: After twelve years in power, Serbia's right-wing populist leader admitted his party lost the crucial electoral contest. He stated it was obvious the ballot, viewed as a test for the nation's direction, resulted in defeat against the student-backed movement.

item.title: Sharon Osbourne Visits Her Late Husband's Grave Daily
item.description: Television personality Sharon Osbourne shares that she goes to the burial location of Ozzy every single day. Her home window offers a direct view of the site, where she frequently communicates with him.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Approaches Andhra Coast as Odisha Prepares
item.description: Cyclone Arnab is projected to make landfall along the Andhra coast by October 28 amid ongoing rainfall in Tamil Nadu. Odisha authorities deployed equipment and personnel, and Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi assigned eight ministers to at-risk regions.

item.title: Australian Parliament convenes as members prepare to honor Helen Haines
item.description: Legislators gather in parliament to remember Helen Haines following an alleged incident. House Speaker Milton Dick plans to urge members to sign a new civility agreement today.

item.title: Brazil runoff ballot counting resumes following court extension
item.description: Following a two-hour voting extension mandated by the supreme court, polling stations in Brazil closed. Balloting updates continued as candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva awaited the final outcome.

item.title: Social Media Videos Claim to Detect Iron Deficiency Visually
item.description: Online clips suggesting that iron deficiency can be diagnosed through facial appearance have garnered millions of views. These viral posts focus on identifying potential health issues through physical looks.

item.title: A Guide to Book Discovery and Reading Tracker Applications
item.description: Multiple software programs are available to help users monitor their reading habits and find new literature. A curated overview highlights top choices to assist individuals in selecting a suitable platform.

item.title: Israeli Election Challenger Eisenkot Holds Final Campaign Event
item.description: Gadi Eisenkot, running against Benjamin Netanyahu in the upcoming Israeli vote, conducted his concluding campaign gathering on Sunday. The event marked the final push ahead of the election.

item.title: Student-Backed Movement Secures Major Election Victory in Serbia
item.description: Festivities broke out throughout Belgrade following a significant electoral triumph by a political movement supported by students. The outcome marks a notable historic win for the group.

item.description: As reported by DW News, Leftist President Lula has defeated right. Key points: Brazilian, President Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro Leftist President Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: China's Leadership Gathering Highlights Xi's Long Anti-Graft Drive
item.description: As senior Chinese officials prepare for the fifth plenum, observers analyze the ongoing anti-corruption campaign initiated by Xi Jinping after he took office in 2012.

item.title: Historian Romila Thapar Discusses Colonial Influences on Indian History
item.description: Historian Romila Thapar argues that Hindu nationalist readings of Indian history rely on colonial-era interpretations. She suggests that prioritizing material evidence like inscriptions could have led to different historical conclusions.

item.title: Former India Cricketer Amit Mishra Opens Up About Depression After Ouster
item.description: Former Indian cricketer Amit Mishra revealed he suffered from depression for 18 months following his removal from the national squad. He noted that a discussion with a selector eventually gave him clarity regarding his exclusion.

item.title: Kannada Film Premada Oorali Surpasses Rs 100 Crore in Domestic Earnings
item.description: The movie Premada Oorali has achieved a major box office milestone by exceeding Rs 100 crore in net Indian collections. After 31 days in cinemas, the feature has accumulated a total of Rs 101.22 crore.

item.title: Australian Parliament Honors Helen Haines as Leaders Pay Tribute
item.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese spearheaded parliamentary tributes for Helen Haines, praising her resilience. Meanwhile, politicians like Angus Taylor and Barnaby Joyce opposed altering parliamentary procedures to lower political tensions.

item.title: Lula da Silva Defeats Flavio Bolsonaro in Brazilian Presidential Election
item.description: Official election outcomes show Lula da Silva securing victory with 51.75 percent of the vote against Flavio Bolsonaro, who garnered 48.25 percent following a close race.

item.title: BJP Plans Nationwide Protests Over Kharge's Comment on Prime Minister Modi
item.description: The BJP is organizing countrywide demonstrations in response to remarks made by Kharge concerning Modi. Additionally, election authorities in Karnataka recorded over 61,000 Form-7 submissions.

item.title: Lula Secures Brazilian Presidency After Defeating Far-Right Challenger
item.description: Left-wing incumbent Lula secured a presidential win in Brazil following a remarkable recovery. The turnaround occurred after an unexpected initial-round defeat mobilized supporters of Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Margot Robbie Neighbours Episodes Adapted Into Vertical Microdramas
item.description: Australian soap opera Neighbours episodes starring Margot Robbie are being reformatted into vertical microdramas. Past actors have raised worries regarding performance rights and consent in this upcoming format.

item.title: Prahaar Reaches Rs 26.78 Crore Globally After Ten Days
item.description: Rajkummar Rao's film Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story experienced higher box office revenue during its second weekend. On its tenth day, the movie brought in Rs 1.20 crore, lifting its global total.

item.title: UK Chancellor Healey Faces Tough Economic Outlook Ahead
item.description: Current economic indicators remain favorable, though the Labour administration may face tougher financial conditions starting in January. Chancellor Healey's upcoming budget must maintain growth despite potential challenges.

item.title: Severe Cyclone Alert in Andhra and Odisha
item.description: Andhra Pradesh prepares for a severe cyclone while Odisha mobilizes disaster response units. Meanwhile, the Regional Meteorological Centre predicts heavy rainfall in multiple Tamil Nadu districts.

item.title: Brazil Leader Lula Secures Re-Election Victory Over Bolsonaro
item.description: Brazilian incumbent leader Lula has won re-election. He successfully defeated right-wing candidate Bolsonaro, an ally of Trump.

item.title: Donald Trump Targets Democratic Candidate Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: Donald Trump launched a sharp verbal attack against Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed. The remarks included renewed anti-Muslim rhetoric from the former president.

item.title: Lula Secures Fourth Presidential Term in Brazil Election
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has achieved a historic political comeback to secure a fourth term as Brazil's president. The leftist incumbent triumphed following a closely contested electoral race.

item.title: Trump Dismisses Immediate Iran Strikes Amid Hebron Raids
item.description: Donald Trump stated he is ruling out military strikes against Iran for the present day. Meanwhile, Israeli military forces conducted raids in the city of Hebron.

item.title: Brazil 2026 runoff election features Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Following an unexpected initial loss, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva competes in a runoff election against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: President Lula Faces Significant Hurdles in Fourth Term
item.description: During his historic fourth term, Brazilian leader Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva will confront a polarized nation and an adversarial Congress. Additional hurdles include weak public finances and potential diplomatic pressures involving Donald Trump.

item.title: Real Madrid defeat Barcelona at Camp Nou in La Liga clash
item.description: Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid secured an away win against Barcelona following a brace by Kylian Mbappe. The result narrows the gap at the top of the La Liga standings.

item.title: Victorian Minister Paul Edbrooke targeted with bullet left on car
item.description: Victorian Emergency Services Minister Paul Edbrooke expressed fear for his family's safety after a bullet marked with the word 'RAT' was left on his vehicle. The incident comes amid growing security concerns for regional and state politicians.

item.title: Padikkal century guides India A past New Zealand A
item.description: Devdutt Padikkal scored a century to help India A secure a first-innings lead. The recovery followed an initial batting collapse at the start of the match.

item.title: Ramayana advance ticket sales approach Rs 25 crore milestone
item.description: Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, Ramayana has sold around 2.16 lakh tickets across 161 cities. Maharashtra and Mumbai lead the strong pre-release booking figures.

item.title: Malayalam film Titans reaches Rs 2.22 crore domestic gross
item.description: The Malayalam movie Titans saw an increase in ticket sales on its fourth day, adding Rs 50 lakhs to its earnings. Total domestic gross for the film now stands at Rs 2.22 crores.

item.title: Venezuelan Dissident María Machado Comes Back Following Exile
item.description: Opposition figure María Machado returned home after spending a month outside the nation prior to the US authorities detaining President Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Man City WSL winning run ends after draw with Man Utd
item.description: Manchester City's flawless start to the Women's Super League concluded after a 1-1 stalemate against rivals Manchester United. Elisabeth Terland scored a late equalizer for United to seal the draw.

item.title: Alderweireld criticizes Manchester United after Bournemouth defeat
item.description: Pundit Toby Alderweireld stated that Manchester United lacked fighting spirit and unity during their 3-0 loss to Bournemouth. The assessment was discussed alongside Ashley Williams on Match of the Day.

item.title: Udta Teer collects Rs 8.10 crore on opening Sunday
item.description: Starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan, the Aakash Kaushik-directed film Udta Teer earned Rs 8.10 crore on Sunday. Its total opening weekend gross reached Rs 19.45 crore.

item.title: Could Yamal break Ronaldo's Ballon d'Or record in 2026?
item.description: Barcelona prodigy Lamine Yamal has the chance to break the record set by Ronaldo Nazario, who secured the Ballon d'Or at 21 years old.

item.title: Pundits review Liverpool's 2-0 victory against Brighton
item.description: Match of the Day analysts Toby Alderweireld and Ashley Williams examined Liverpool's strong offensive performance during their 2-0 win over Brighton at Anfield.

item.title: Indian stock markets prepare for a turbulent trading week
item.description: Investors on Dalal Street are getting ready for potential market fluctuations in the upcoming days.

item.title: Examining the career trajectory of Australian batsman Labuschagne
item.description: Marnus Labuschagne has received numerous opportunities, yet Australian cricket has a tradition of dropping players who struggle against South Africa.

item.title: Drishyam 3 brings in Rs 3 crore on its fourth Sunday
item.description: The film starring Ajay Devgn and Tabu experienced a 13.2% rise in domestic ticket sales on its fourth Sunday, bringing its total national earnings to Rs 441.95 crore.

item.title: Ranabaali box office collection reaches Rs 53 crore on day 10
item.description: Following a solid debut, the movie Ranabaali experienced a slight increase in ticket sales on its second Sunday, collecting Rs 2.90 crore and raising its total net earnings to Rs 53 crore.

item.title: Prague protesters rally against proposed public media funding changes
item.description: Protesters argue that the legislative changes proposed by Prime Minister Andrej Babiš and his government threaten freedom of the press.

item.title: Lula da Silva secures fourth presidential term in Brazil
item.description: At nearly 81 years old, incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won a runoff election against Flavio Bolsonaro with 51.7% of the vote.

item.title: Using standard Ethernet wires outdoors
item.description: Standard indoor Ethernet cables are generally not recommended for outdoor applications. Weather exposure can damage the wiring over time.

item.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić concedes defeat after vote
item.description: A massive turnout driven by student protests appears to conclude Aleksandar Vučić's twelve-year governance. The long-term Serbian leader has acknowledged his electoral loss.

item.title: Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela
item.description: Venezuelan opposition figure and Nobel laureate Maria Corina Machado came back to the country following an absence of over ten months in exile.

item.title: Serbia election challenges Vučić's rule
item.description: Serbian voters head to the polls as long-serving leader Aleksandar Vučić faces opposition from the Student List movement. Ipsos and Cesid estimate voter turnout at 60.8 percent amid ongoing anti-corruption protests.

item.title: Brazil holds decisive presidential runoff election
item.description: Brazilian citizens head to the polls to choose their next leader in a tense second-round election. The contest features incumbent leftist leader Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva against conservative senator Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Jailer 2 global box office exceeds Rs 710 crore
item.description: Rajinikanth's action movie Jailer 2 surpassed Rs 710.35 crore globally by its eleventh day. The film achieved a strong domestic collection of Rs 25.70 crore on its second Sunday.
